about: The pulse: weekly totals from public vulnerability sources, for products and vendors relevant to Portugal, kept as a history. Weak signals, not an audit. Aggregates only.
state_note: Worldwide totals from CISA KEV and NVD, read from data.promptugal.news. The Portugal lens (vendors relevant to Portugal) is not built yet.
limits: never a list of IPs, hosts, devices, domains or exposed services
no victim data and no link to a leak site
anything specific to an organisation reported privately to CERT.PT or CNCS, never published
no scanning or probing of our own
no cell under 5 is shown on its own (it is merged or shown as fewer than 5)

series.title: CVEs added to CISA's known-exploited list, per week, worldwide
series.source: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (CC0), via https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/cisa-kev/latest.json (CC BY 4.0, PrompTugal.news)

series.title: New CVEs in NVD in the 24 hours before each read, worldwide, by severity band
series.source: NVD CVE API 2.0, via https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/nvd-cve/latest.json (CC BY 4.0, PrompTugal.news). The totals are ours, counted from NVD's values.
series.notice: This product uses the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.

caveat: Worldwide totals. Counts reflect the activity of public catalogues, not how secure anyone is. Weak signals, not an audit.
